reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the cited text supports it: § 12.3 expressly preserves Customer's freedom to hire any person responding to general recruitment and records Vendor's acknowledgement that Customer has made no no-hire commitment, so no restrictive covenant binds our client.
No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is the correct handling for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraph (no unintended edits).

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are non-probative here because both presuppose an existing non-solicit binding Customer; adding such wording would create a restriction where none exists and downgrade the preferred position to the fallback.

Search record is credible and the scope exclusion is sound: § 12.4 binds Vendor (non-compete against Customer's products) and therefore falls outside a rule targeting restrictive covenants on Customer.
